# ===== PRESET: DEMON (super deep + screechy horror) =====
# Gate -> Octave-down double voice -> Horror EQ (rumble + screech band) -> Heavy distortion -> Compressor -> De-esser

# Noise gate
VSTPlugin: Library "ATKExpander x64.dll" Attack 0.097959 Release 1 Threshold 0.531507 Softness 1 Slope 0.142134
# Level (offsets the heavy distortion's +13 dB and the full-wet pitch shift)
Preamp: -4.5 dB

# Octave down (-12), 100% shifted: none of your normal voice passes through
# Pitch -12 st, formant -4 st (GForm: cleaner than pitchproof on speech)
VSTPlugin: Library "GForm.dll" Form 0.33125 Pitch -0.002083 Oversmp 0 MinFreq 0.163054 MaxFreq 0.7818 Gate 0.1429
# Horror EQ
Filter: ON HPQ Fc 45 Hz Q 0.707
# Earth-shaking rumble
Filter: ON PK Fc 80 Hz Gain 6 dB Q 0.9
# Weight
Filter: ON PK Fc 150 Hz Gain 2 dB Q 1.0
# Scoop the mud so the rumble and screech both stand out
Filter: ON PK Fc 500 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 1.0
# SCREECH: sharp resonant rasp
Filter: ON PK Fc 2800 Hz Gain 6 dB Q 2.5
# Hiss/sizzle on top of the screech
Filter: ON PK Fc 4500 Hz Gain 3 dB Q 2.0
# Keep extreme highs from turning into pure noise
Filter: ON HSC Fc 7000 Hz Gain -4 dB

# Heavy distortion: growl + grind (Density 2.0, 100% wet)
VSTPlugin: Library "Density364.dll" ChunkData "mpkZPwAAAAAAAIA/AACAPw=="

# Compressor: keeps the monster huge and in your face
VSTPlugin: Library "TDR Kotelnikov.dll" ChunkData ""

# De-esser
VSTPlugin: Library "T-De-Esser 2.dll" ChunkData ""
